assistant|fertilizer_dosing: Start with 1-2 teaspoons per 10 gallons of water, 1-2 times a week; start low and adjust.
assistant|npk_functions: Nitrogen promotes leaf growth and green color; phosphorus promotes root growth and flowers; potassium promotes overall health and disease resistance.
assistant|micronutrient_roles: Micronutrients are needed for photosynthesis, chlorophyll synthesis, enzyme function, and cell wall development.
assistant|iron_deficiency_symptoms: Iron deficiency causes chlorosis (yellowing/whitening of leaves), stunted growth, and increased disease susceptibility.

assistant|temperature_management_tips: Avoid sudden temperature changes, maintain consistent temperature, monitor extremes from sunlight or heaters.
assistant|small_tank_temperature_conside: Small tanks are prone to temperature fluctuations; a low-wattage heater may be needed if room temperature is unstable.
assistant|small_tank_maintenance: For the 1-gallon tank: do 10-20% water changes weekly and monitor pH, ammonia, nitrite, and nitrate.
assistant|small_tank_lighting_advice: Provide adequate lighting but avoid direct sunlight, which causes algae growth and temperature fluctuations.
assistant|plant_introduction_advice: Introduce plants slowly and in small quantities to avoid overwhelming the tank's ecosystem.

llm_738663_6_112: Recommended beginner-friendly plants: Amazon Swords, Cabomba, Water Wisteria, Anubias, and Hornwort.
llm_738663_7_113: Amazon Swords care: tolerate low to high lighting, prefer 5-15 dGH, pH 6.5-8.5, and 72-82°F.
llm_738663_8_114: Water Wisteria care: prefers moderate to high lighting, 5-15 dGH, pH 6.5-8.5, and 72-82°F.
llm_738663_9_115: Recommended balanced fertilizers: Seachem Flourish, API Aquarium Fertilizer, and Tropica Plant Nutrition.
llm_738663_10_116: Recommended iron supplements: Seachem Iron, API Iron Supplement, and Tropica Iron Fertilizer.
llm_738663_11_117: Ideal temperature ranges: Amazon Swords 72-82°F, Water Wisteria 75-85°F.
llm_738663_v0_118: Amazon Swords (Echinocorys spp.), Water Wisteria (Hygrophila difformis), Cabomba (Cabomba caroliniana), Hornwort (Ceratophyllum demersum), Anubias (Anubias spp.)
llm_738663_v1_119: Amazon Swords produce more vibrant colors and grow faster in moderate to high lighting (2-4 watts per gallon).
llm_738663_v2_120: Water Wisteria prefers moderate to high lighting (2-4 watts per gallon) but tolerates low light with slower growth.
llm_738663_v3_121: Amazon Swords have a small root system; nutrient-rich substrate of 1-2 inches (2.5-5 cm) is sufficient.
llm_738663_v4_122: Water Wisteria has a moderate root system and prefers deeper substrate of 2-3 inches (5-7.5 cm).
llm_738663_v5_123: Amazon Swords can grow up to 20 inches (50 cm) tall, requiring regular pruning.
llm_738663_v6_124: Water Wisteria can grow up to 30 inches (75 cm) long, requiring regular pruning.
llm_738663_v7_125: Amazon Swords propagate by dividing the rhizome or planting seeds produced by the plant.
llm_738663_v8_126: Water Wisteria propagates by cutting stem tips (2-3 inches long), dividing roots, or via runners.
llm_738663_v9_127: Both plants benefit from balanced fertilizer (e.g., 10-10-10 NPK) per manufacturer's instructions.
llm_738663_v10_128: Provide adequate water circulation and oxygenation; avoid over-handling plants; monitor growth and adjust placement.
llm_738663_v11_129: API CO2 Booster is primarily for CO2 boost and is not a comprehensive fertilizer for aquatic plants.
llm_738663_v12_130: Start with 1-2 teaspoons per 10 gallons of water, 1-2 times a week; start low and adjust.
llm_738663_v13_131: Nitrogen promotes leaf growth and green color; phosphorus promotes root growth and flowers; potassium promotes overall health and disease resistance.
llm_738663_v14_132: Micronutrients are needed for photosynthesis, chlorophyll synthesis, enzyme function, and cell wall development.
llm_738663_v15_133: Iron deficiency causes chlorosis (yellowing/whitening of leaves), stunted growth, and increased disease susceptibility.
llm_738663_v16_134: Look for fertilizers with chelated iron (iron gluconate or iron EDTA) for better plant absorption.
llm_738663_v17_135: Tolerable ranges: Amazon Swords 68-86°F (20-30°C); Water Wisteria 70-90°F (21-32°C).
llm_738663_v18_136: Avoid sudden temperature changes, maintain consistent temperature, monitor extremes from sunlight or heaters.
llm_738663_v19_137: Small tanks are prone to temperature fluctuations; a low-wattage heater may be needed if room temperature is unstable.
llm_738663_v20_138: For the 1-gallon tank: do 10-20% water changes weekly and monitor pH, ammonia, nitrite, and nitrate.
llm_738663_v21_139: Provide adequate lighting but avoid direct sunlight, which causes algae growth and temperature fluctuations.
llm_738663_v22_140: Introduce plants slowly and in small quantities to avoid overwhelming the tank's ecosystem.
